exposure: Indication of previous caesarean section (e.g., breech presentation, failed induction)
outcome: Successful trial of labour (defined as vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC) without complications for mother and baby)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women with one previous caesarean delivery, presenting with singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation at a gestation age of 37 weeks or more between 2018 and 2022.
finding: The new DEVI-CS prediction model, based on easily captured clinical variables, showed good discrimination and agreement in quantifying the chances of a successful trial of labour after a previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: The DEVI-CS model can aid in shared decision-making regarding the mode of delivery among women planning a trial of labour after caesarean section.
